reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Double Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: This moisturizing mask has quickly become a staple in my routine, primarily because of its perfect gel consistency. Unlike other serums that tend to be runny and messy, this one stays exactly where I apply it, meaning no frustrating drips down my face or neck. It provides a fantastic boost of hydration that leaves my skin feeling plump and refreshed.
reviews.zh: 呢款保濕面膜好快就成為我 routine 入面嘅必備品，主要係因為佢嘅 gel 質地剛剛好。唔似其他精華液咁水汪汪又亂黐，呢款搽去邊就留喺邊，唔會滴到成面成頸都係，咁就冇咁崩潰。佢提供到超強保濕力，用完皮膚飽滿又清爽。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Double Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Not the easiest to put on but its certainly very moisturising. Just make sure to put it no longer than 30 nins
reviews.zh: 唔算最易搽，但的確好保濕。記住敷嘅時間唔好超過 30 分鐘。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Double Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text:
Very nice for oily skin.
From start to end you never feel sticky as so light but your your skin softer and smoother.
reviews.zh:
油性肌用好正。
由頭到尾都唔會覺得黏笠，質地超輕，但用完皮膚會變得柔軟又滑。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Double Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: These didn’t break me out and are hydrating but I find the mask doesn’t stick nicely to your face and it’s not stretchy at all. The mask is smaller than ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Water Gel Sheet Mask. This is not the worst mask but also not the greatest, just average.
reviews.zh: 呢款唔會令我爆瘡，保濕度都夠，但我就覺得塊面膜唔貼面，而且完全唔夠彈性。塊面膜細過 ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Water Gel Sheet Mask。唔係最差嘅面膜，但都唔算最好，普普通通。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Double Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: very rich in the actual serum/essence which i like, but takes a while to absorb. very cooling though.
reviews.zh: 精華／原液本身好豐富呢點我鍾意，但要一段時間先吸收到。不過涼感好勁。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Double Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: I really loved this mask! It left my skin feeling hydrated, soft, and refreshed. After just one use, my skin looked healthier and more radiant. I would definitely purchase it again.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢塊面膜！用完皮膚覺得保濕、柔軟又清爽。淨係用一次，皮膚已經望落健康同有光澤啲。我一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Double Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: love it very much!! i use it when i feel very dry skin, and it becomes moisturizing!!!i will buy it next time!
reviews.zh: 勁鍾意！！皮膚好乾嘅時候我就會用，即刻變得好保濕！！！下次會再買！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Double Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: The masks are thin but the essence feels so moisturizing. Mind you, if there's anyone with allergies to birch tree (like my sister), this may not be for you. Otherwise, a really great pick me up for your face!
reviews.zh: 面膜紙薄但精華好保濕。提一提，如果有人對樺樹敏感（好似我阿妹），呢款就未必適合你。否則嘅話，真係急救塊面嘅好選擇！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
